scope: Questions about operating the document conversion service, handling failed conversion jobs, and arranging conversion or client onboarding handoffs, including follow-up questions about these tasks.

cases.question: What should I do after a conversion job partially writes its output and then fails?
cases.rubric: Escalate to service owner, record job identifier, and do not retry without confirmation that output will not be duplicated.

sources.title: Fictional conversion service runbook
sources.text: The conversion service validates the input schema, converts the document, and writes output to storage. Each job has a unique job identifier. After a partial write, escalate to the service owner and record the job identifier. Do not retry until the owner confirms that another attempt will not duplicate output. A schema mismatch requires investigation before repeating the job. A transient transport failure may be retried only after confirming that no output was written. This runbook does not specify prices, a universal retry count, or response-time commitments.

sources.title: Fictional conversion handoff
sources.text: For the conversion handoff, send the job identifier and incident summary to the service owner. This handoff concerns a failed conversion job. The service owner decides whether a retry is safe.

sources.title: Fictional client onboarding handoff
sources.text: For the client onboarding handoff, send the signed onboarding checklist and client contact details to the account manager. This handoff concerns onboarding a new client, not a failed conversion job.
